scope: Exact C-Gate3.4 MMI coverage readers; independently tested missing-range fault; no hardware claim

evidence.meaning: Resets state, builds install MMI broadcast05FF00FAFF00, expects up to7 response lines.
Latches unexpected offset, advances next address from payload length, finishes beyond255; b=true permits finish despite latched offset error.
Disables b before initialization resets b=true; accepts at least3 individually valid lines and returns dx without checking offset flag/full coverage.
Checks checksum/application and writes four low-to-high two-bit address states per payload byte.
Zero-initializes256 states; no separate coverage mask distinguishes missing from explicitly zero.
All selected addresses are gated by fresh MMI membership; absent map entries receive absent classification without scheduling a serial seeker.
Calls CBusBaseNetwork.a(oQ,null,true), which uses r/dw; alternate a(aX,boolean) directly uses dw.
NET PINGU selects dk.a(context,null,true), then reports302-Units plus200.
No-retry flag sets q=0; rejects unexpected offsets and fewer than3 lines; merges parsed state through dn coverage validation.
Requires every address in the incoming result to have an explicitly filled coverage flag before merging.

known_limit: NET SYNC/CHECKUNIT do not expose raw MMI coverage. Explicit selected addresses alone do not compensate for missing-range acceptance. PINGU guard now protects typed physical address writes; raw behavior is unchanged.
